atlas-logo.name: atlas-logo.txt
atlas-logo.content:
Northstar Atlas wordmark, 2026 refresh.
Primary #1a73e8 on #ffffff; clear space is one cap height on every side.
Do not stretch the mark, recolour it, or set it in outline.

launch-checklist.name: launch-checklist.txt
launch-checklist.content:
Frozen copy of the launch checklist, kept for the record.
The live one is http://docs.google.com/documents/atlas-launch and it is the
only copy anyone should be editing after the review.

press-kit.name: press-kit.txt
press-kit.content:
Press kit contents
- One paragraph on what Atlas is, in plain words, no adjectives.
- The wordmark, light and dark.
- Two screenshots of the renderer, taken at 1440 wide.
- Carol Nakamura is the named contact for press questions.

release-notes.name: release-notes.txt
release-notes.content:
Release notes, draft 4
- Deterministic renderer: the same world and seed produce the same pixels.
- Snapshot round trip is now byte-exact, including page state.
- Known issue: the BFS path test still fails on Windows only.
  Tracked at http://github.com/northstar/atlas

demo-script.name: demo-script.txt
demo-script.content:
Walkthrough script, six minutes
0:00 Open a world, show the seed.
1:10 Run it twice, diff the frames, get nothing.
3:20 Break determinism on purpose, show the diff light up.
5:00 Snapshot, restore, keep going from the same tick.

faq.name: faq.txt
faq.content:
Q. Is the renderer deterministic across platforms?
A. Yes. Text metrics come from the bundled typeface, never the host.
Q. What happens to a world on restore?
A. It resumes at the tick it was snapshotted on, with identical state.
